_comment: One flagship per provider, the newest generally available model on the day (no preview or experimental IDs). Prices are USD per 1M tokens, standard tier, read from each provider's own pricing page on read_on. Settings are sent verbatim; temperature 0 wherever the model accepts it.

openai.settings_note: temperature is refused by gpt-6-astra (HTTP 400 "Unsupported parameter: 'temperature' is not supported with this model"), so it runs at the provider default; reasoning effort left at the default.

google.price_note: $2.00 input / $0.10 context caching (implicit only) / $10.00 output through 30 Nov 2026 ($4.00 / $0.20 / $20.00 from 1 Dec 2026), standard paid tier.

xai.price_note: Prompts under 200k tokens; cached input billed at the input price here (the models page gives no cached price), an overestimate.

anthropic.price_note: Cache writes at the 5-minute rate ($12.50); cache hits $0.25.

web_search.note: Condition C only. $10 per 1,000 searches plus standard token costs; search results are billed as input tokens; a search that errors is not billed. web_search_20260318 is the newest version on the day; its default allowed_callers runs searches through code execution (dynamic filtering), which carries no charge beyond tokens. response_inclusion left at the default (full), so every consulted URL is in the response. The Models API reported capabilities.server_tools.web_search.supported = true for claude-fable-5-1 on 2026-10-28.

anthropic.settings_note: temperature is refused by claude-fable-5-1 (HTTP 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model"), so it runs at the provider default; adaptive thinking is always on and effort is left at the default (high).
